name: NRE 4000W
title: Natural Resources Planning and Management
description: Concepts and methods of planning for the allocation, management and utilization of terrestrial and aquatic ecosystems. Techniques and methods of managerial decision making. Written technical reports required.
requirement_description: Senior standing; ENGL 1007 or 1010 or 1011; open only to Natural Resources and Environmental Science majors, or by instructor consent.
